use_case_name: Initialize a Newly Online Control Unit

claims.content: To identify the control unit and initialize all its associated device sensors upon coming online.

goal.raw_text: To identify the control unit and initialize all its associated device sensors upon coming online.

claims.content: Control Unit
The control unit (workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU) has come online.
The RLCS software in the field shall first identify its unit when it starts, by reading the cabinet id.
All required cards in that unit are present and working properly.
The control unit (workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU) comes online.

trigger.raw_text: The control unit (workstation or intelligent controller at the FCU or DCU) comes online.

claims.content: The RLCS software shall first identify its unit when it starts, by reading the cabinet id.
The RLCS software will then proceed to make sure that all the cards required in that unit are present and working properly.
The RLCS software will do a control system integrity check (see requirement 3.0.9) and initialize all the specified tables.
If everything is OK the start up process shall not exceed 30 seconds.
The RLCS software shall then monitor all the devices and send the current status to the FCU or TSU every 2 seconds (or at the rate specified in the System Control Parameters for the current mode).
If the control system integrity check fails or required cards are not present/working properly, the start up process shall not complete within 30 seconds.
If initialization fails, the RLCS software shall not proceed to monitor devices or send status updates to FCU or TSU.
If a status from any device is not received upon request, the system shall automatically request the status again.
Failure to receive a valid status after a configurable number of retries shall be considered a device failure.
If the start up process exceeds 30 seconds due to integrity check failure or missing/failed cards, initialization is considered failed and monitoring/status reporting does not proceed.
The control unit is identified by the RLCS software.
All required cards in the unit are confirmed present and working properly.
A control system integrity check has been performed (per requirement 3.0.9).
All specified tables have been initialized.
The startup process completed within 30 seconds.
The RLCS software is monitoring all devices associated with the control unit.
Current device status is being sent to the FCU or TSU every 2 seconds (or at the rate specified in System Control Parameters for the current mode).
